name: Quickshell
description:
Quickshell is a flexible framework for building custom desktop shells, status bars, notification daemons, and system widgets using QML and QtQuick. It gives users complete control over their desktop interface design.

Features:
- Declarative UI creation leveraging modern QML and JavaScript syntax
- Deep Linux desktop integration with Wayland (layer-shell) and X11 support
- System service bindings for battery, audio volume, network, and window management
- Hot-reloading capabilities enabling real-time visual feedback during widget creation
- Exceptionally fast rendering and low CPU utilization
